name: Rhys Llewellyn
bio:
Rhys's journey into motorsport began in his grandfather's workshop, where he spent countless hours learning the intricacies of metalwork and engine repair. He honed his skills through apprenticeships with local engineering firms, eventually specializing in high-performance engine components. He joined Hansen World RX Team five years ago, drawn by the team's commitment to pushing the boundaries of rallycross technology.

Rhys is known for his meticulous attention to detail and his ability to diagnose and resolve mechanical issues quickly and efficiently. He approaches his work with a quiet intensity, always striving for perfection. He is a firm believer in preventative maintenance and is always looking for ways to improve the reliability and performance of the team's machinery. Rhys is a valuable asset to the team, providing a critical link between engineering design and on-track performance. He is demanding of himself and his colleagues, always pushing for excellence.

physical.description: A stocky man with strong hands and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always sharpens his tools before each job.
Drinks copious amounts of strong tea.
Muttering technical details to himself while working.
